title: Record application status and notes
summary: Find a job retained by Cast and append the user’s reported status or notes without requiring a prepared packet. Read current status and immutable history, or append a correction.

interfaces.label: Record a report
interfaces.invocation: clew record --cast-job JOB_ID --id WRITE_ID --status STATUS --notes TEXT

interfaces.label: Correct a report
interfaces.invocation: clew record --cast-job JOB_ID --id WRITE_ID --replaces ENTRY_ID --status STATUS --notes TEXT

consumers.statement: The user and their conversational agent record explicitly reported application history.

preconditions.statement: Clew schema-two state is initialized. A first record for a Cast job requires the installed Cast snapshot reader. Existing exact jobs and retries remain writable while Cast is unavailable.

inputs.statement: Record requires --cast-job JOB_ID, a caller-supplied write ID and at least one nonblank status or notes value. The positional reference form accepts only a retained legacy Platter alias. Status is free text. Optional replaces selects one active record. Retract selects an active record and a new write ID.

outputs.statement: Schema-two JSON with ok and data returns committed entries, current records, complete histories or candidate search results. Entries expose canonical cast_job_id and optional platter_job_ref for the original legacy argument.

data_semantics.statement: Status is user-supplied. Current status is the last status in an active record by ledger sequence; notes never assign it. A replacement is a complete new latest report, not a patch. Retractions and replacements preserve old rows and exclude the target from current reads.

identity_and_units.statement: Each write ID binds exact immutable content and its original target namespace. Migration preserves legacy arguments and aliases; changing an old write to --cast-job is conflicting content. Cast job IDs identify tracked jobs. Sequence orders committed entries. recorded_at is UTC RFC3339 recording time, not the date an application or reply occurred.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: List covers all active ledger records; show includes a job history and corrections to those records. Find combines one complete retained Cast export with matches in all Clew notes, including superseded notes and legacy aliases. The two product reads are separate snapshots. Notes matches are clues, not identity proof. Failed Cast reads are errors, not complete empty results.

access.statement: Current-user local CLI; Clew owns its private SQLite ledger. Candidate search is read-only. The caller resolves ambiguity before invoking record.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Each append is one immediate SQLite transaction with synchronous FULL. Exact retries return the original entry; conflicting write IDs fail. SQL triggers prohibit entry updates and deletes. Existing state is never migrated implicitly.

operational_limits.statement: Complete reads use memory proportional to retained history. SQLite waits up to five seconds for contention; no hard command latency or corpus size guarantee exists.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Clew ledger and CLI output schemas are two. Coordinated deployment migrates schema-one state with an exclusive write boundary, private backup and exact legacy mappings. Original rows and retry identities remain unchanged. Ordinary commands refuse unsupported state. There is no automatic retention cleanup.

reliances.statement: Cast supplies stable job identities, companies, job metadata and URLs through its complete retained snapshot interface. Platter packet preparation is not required.

use_when: The user reports applying, a response, rejection, or another status or note about a job retained by Cast.
The user wants application history, current supplied status, or correction of a mistaken entry.
do_not_use_when: The caller wants automatic status inference, application submission, job discovery, employer contact or scheduled monitoring.
outcome: A durable append-only report linked to one exact Cast job, or a complete selected read.
effects: Find, list and show read private records. Record and retract append ledger rows. No command sends, applies, collects jobs, or starts a model.
authority: The user supplies every status. The agent resolves a target using tools and conversation, and clarifies material ambiguity before writing. Clew owns the ledger; Cast owns job identity and details.
success: A write succeeds only after its row commits and returns its entry ID. An exact retry returns that same entry.
failure_and_recovery: Retry an uncertain write with the same ID and identical arguments. Conflicting IDs, unavailable new references and invalid corrections fail without appending.
An unavailable Cast search fails explicitly. Clew list/show, exact retries and updates to already known exact jobs remain available.
privacy: Notes, statuses and references remain in private local state and command output. Do not commit them or send them elsewhere without user authorization.
does_not_authorize: Deriving status from employer pages, mail, delivery state or elapsed time; choosing among ambiguous jobs; collecting jobs, editing Cast or Platter, or contacting an employer.
